description: High Ecological Value Waterways and Water Dependent Ecosystems - MOSMAN LGA is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. A map of the high ecological value waterways and water dependent ecosystems for the Mosman LGA was prepared by the Science Division of the Department of Planning, Industry and Environment, with input layers and support for the map provided by the former NSW Department of Primary Industries-Fisheries and Department of Industry-Crown Lands and Water. Coverage: NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Its tags are Coastal Wetlands, Groundwater, HEV_water, Riparian Lands Watercourses. It offers 4 resource(s) in JPEG, PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-11-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
